acceptance_criteria.gate4: aggregate expected_value_score improvement with all standard windows checked
acceptance_criteria.production_parity: replay-only unless a shared production core-position context adapter is added
acceptance_criteria.protocol: docs/backtesting.md standard three non-overlapping half-year windows
acceptance_criteria.sample_guard: target >=15 trades, 3 windows, >=10 tickers, win rate >=60%, concentration guarded

hypothesis: Event overlay rows that are independent of active core positions have higher replacement value than rows duplicating existing core exposure, so a small independent-context notional scalar may improve expected_value_score without adding noisy tickers.
why_this_direction: LLM soft-ranking remains attribution-sparse, broad-market local allocation is blocked by candidate-universe identity drift, and state-surface allocation/profile retunes face the strict >10% aggregate EV gate after many nearby trials.
